headline: AIE蛍光色素は、タンパク質に結びつくと環の回転が止まって光る
subhead: ペプチドをつないだAIE分子とhPin1-WWドメインの複合体を、NMRの溶液構造で解析した

summary.question: AIE（凝集誘起発光）リガンドがタンパク質に結合した複合体の構造は、これまで報告されていなかった。
summary.approach: hPin1-WWの結合配列をつないだAIEペプチドを作り、蛍光滴定で結合を調べ、遊離状態と複合体の溶液NMR構造を決めた。
summary.result: 遊離のF11はペプチドが芳香環の上に巻き付く。結合すると伸びて、hPin1-WWのF25などが芳香環に接触した。
summary.learned: 芳香環がタンパク質表面に固定されて動きが制限されるため、結合すると蛍光が強くなる。

question.quote: However, so far, the structure of an AIE-ligand:protein complex has not been published.

approach.quote: While an AIE fluorophore with two conjugated peptides shows an enhanced fluorescence increase upon protein binding, a one-armed derivative enabled us to solve the structures of the free AIE-peptide and its complex.

result.quote: In the absence of a protein, the AIE-peptide conjugate shows a curled-up conformation that still allows rotation of the aromatic rings of the AIE-core, thus resulting in low auto-fluorescence.
Residue F25 of hPin1-WW rotates into the centre of the C-shape, forming face-to-edge π–π interactions with the central and distal aromatic rings of the AIE-core (Fig. 4b).
result.section: NMR solution structure of F11 bound to hPin1-WW

learned.quote: The aromatic rings of the AIE-core form additional contacts with the protein surface, which restricts their motions and thus results in the observed fluorescence increase.

open.quote: Each protein:AIE-peptide system will require optimization of the linker length between AIE and peptide recognition sequence to allow the AIE to reach its ideal spot on the protein surface.

highlights.text: 遊離のF11では、ペプチドがらせん状にAIEコアの上に巻き付き、プロリン環が芳香環とCH–π相互作用をつくる。近位の環は回転できるため、単独では蛍光が弱い。結合したF11は伸びた形になるが、最初のペプチド結合はcis型のままである。

evidence.quote: The peptide arm is curled up in a helical fashion above the aromatic core, such that the hydrophobic proline ring interacts with the proximal (closest to the peptide) and central aromatic rings.
evidence.section: Solution structure of AIE-peptide F11 with one peptide arm

evidence.quote: The AIE-peptide F11 is draped over the saddle-shaped top of the central hPin1-WW β-sheet and no longer in a curled-up conformation; however, the first peptide bond remains in cis conformation.
evidence.section: NMR solution structure of F11 bound to hPin1-WW

highlights.text: AIEコアはC字形のままβシートの上に載り、F25が中央に入り込んでコアと接触する。R14はカチオン–π相互作用でコアを支え、M15の側鎖は既知のhPin1-WW構造にない上向きの形で、トリアゾール環の方を向く。

evidence.quote: Residue R14 is also involved in stabilizing the aromatic AIE-core of F11 by cation–π interactions.
evidence.section: NMR solution structure of F11 bound to hPin1-WW

evidence.quote: Residue M15 displays a conformation that is unique among all known hPin1-WW structures (apo and peptide-bound).
evidence.section: NMR solution structure of F11 bound to hPin1-WW

highlights.text: クリック反応でペプチドをAIEコアにつなぐと、さまざまなペプチド結合タンパク質向けの直接読み出しプローブにできる。2本腕のF21–F24は蛍光の増加がF11より5〜9倍大きく、リンカーは短いほうが凝集しにくい。著者は、F11のKDが対照ペプチドより小さくならなかった点も注意している。

evidence.quote: Coupling of peptides to the AIE-core via click chemistry offers a convenient system to pair the AIE properties with a multitude of peptides to target a variety of peptide-binding proteins.
The fluorescence amplitude of F11 (with one peptide) upon protein binding was 5–9-fold lower compared to that of the two-armed fluorophores.
evidence.section: Aggregation-induced emission enhancement (AIEE) for the quantitative characterisation of protein binding via direct read-out

evidence.quote: Interestingly, the binding affinity does not improve but rather the KD slightly increases for the AIE-peptides compared to the native control peptide P0

lab_notes.construct: AIEコアに1本（F11）または2本（F21–F26）のペプチドをつなぐ。ペプチドはhPin1-WWの認識配列pThr-Proを含み、N末端にアジドホモアラニンをもつ。
lab_notes.purification: ペプチドは標準的な固相合成（FMOC法）で作り、HPLCで精製。TFAは塩化物イオンに置換。
lab_notes.sample_prep: AIEペプチドと、Cu(I)触媒のクリック反応でカップリング。
lab_notes.data_collection: 15N標識hPin1-WWにAIEペプチドを加えたNMR滴定と、蛍光滴定でKDを求めた。

evidence.quote: Peptides P1–P6 with an N-terminal azido-homoalanine (Aha) residue were synthesized via standard solid phase peptide synthesis using FMOC chemistry, deprotected and purified by HPLC.
The TFA ions were exchanged with chloride to avoid possible interference of protein binding by trifluoroacetate (TFA) ions present after HPLC purification.
Recognition of the pThr-Pro motif in F11 and F21–F24 by the hPin1-WW domain was confirmed by NMR, titrating peptide-conjugated AIE fluorophores to 15N-labelled hPin1-WW
evidence.section: Aggregation-induced emission enhancement (AIEE) for the quantitative characterisation of protein binding via direct read-out

editor_notes: PDB 29KP（遊離F11）・29KQ（hPin1-WW複合体）は未公開。実験条件の詳細（NMR測定など）は補足資料にあり、本文パケットには含まれない。論文は「AIEリガンドとタンパク質の初の溶液NMR構造」と明言しているが、見出しには使っていない。
